prompt: Look at the Upcoming section of my 'Reef aquarium' area. What is the earliest upcoming date that has anything scheduled, how many items fall on that date, and how many distinct dates have items? Reply with JSON {"first_date": "YYYY-MM-DD", "first_count": N, "distinct_dates": M}.
paraphrases: In the 'Reef aquarium' area's Upcoming list, tell me the soonest scheduled date, the number of items on it, and how many separate dates carry items. JSON {"first_date": "YYYY-MM-DD", "first_count": N, "distinct_dates": M}.
For my Reef aquarium area: soonest upcoming day, how many items on that day, and total number of days that have anything. JSON {"first_date": "YYYY-MM-DD", "first_count": N, "distinct_dates": M}.
pseudoScript: things area show "Reef aquarium" --json | jq '.data.view.children.upcoming | {first_date: .[0].when, first_count: (.[0].items|length), distinct_dates: length}'
